text:
maya: Heads-up — staging got a bump to checkpoint v3.2.0 (locale-aware tokenizer) and p99 spiked on batch QPS tests. Anyone else seeing this? cc @liam

ops-bot: deployed checkpoint v3.2.0 to staging (deploy-1234)

liam: saw p95/p99 jump on coral-2 pools. Kernel selector switched to fallback_quant for ~20% of requests with long token sequences, and kv cache eviction rate shot up.

sarah: repro on my laptop with `make perf-run TARGET=staging --batch=64` — profiler shows heavy memcpy in `cuda_kernel_spill` and batch scheduler backpressure.

maya: CI flagged a perf regression in canary last night (ci-bot: test perf/throughput/batching failed). That was ignored because unit tests passed.

jen: quick bisect idea — rollback the tokenizer compat patch (merge a1b2c3) on staging and re-run the nightly perf. If it goes away, we know it's tokenization changes causing different length distribution -> kernel misroute.

liam: attaching short logs:
```
[2026-03-18T08:12:23Z] kernel: selector_decision=fast_mm
[2026-03-18T08:12:23Z] kernel: new_decision=fallback_quant reason=token_length>1024 locale=ja
[2026-03-18T08:12:24Z] kvcache: evict_rate=78% inflight_batches=12
```

rahul: created ticket PERF-789; starting canary rollback now. tagging @eng-runtime on priority.

jen: also saw the tokenizer now emits ZWJ sequences for some locales which increases token count by 1-3 on average. Batching heuristics assume older distribution; need to update `batch_size_from_length()` thresholds.

liam: agreed. Short-term: rollback v3.2.0 on staging and pin to v3.1.9 for the dedicated pool. Mid-term: add length-distribution sampling to onboarding job and update kernel selector thresholds + unit perf test.

maya: action list:
1) rahul — rollback staging (in progress) :leftwards_arrow_with_hook:
2) jen — add a perf unit test that simulates ZWJ-heavy inputs
3) liam — update kernel selector to prefer fast_mm when kv eviction>50% and seq_len median < 1200
4) sarah — run a 6h canary with pinned v3.1.9 and collect p95/p99

ci-bot: perf job queued: perf/throughput/batching on staging (run-4521)

sarah: I'm on the canary run and will paste results. if rollback doesn't drop p99 we'll bisect the serving runtime commits from last 48h.

maya: thanks — please update ticket PERF-789 with results. :eyes:
